kyrgyzstan: Kyrgyzstan is a landlocked country in South-Central Asia. The capital city is Bishkek.
kyrgyz: Kyrgyz is a Turkic language spoken in Kyrgyzstan.
A Kyrgyz is a person or thing that comes from Kyrgyzstan.
Something or someone that is Kyrgyz comes from Kyrgyzstan.
The Kyrgyz currency is the Som.
kyoto: Kyoto is a city and the former capital (794-1869) in Japan.
